name: Dear Maiden
source:
The princess of Augland has turned 21. As successor to the kingdom, she must marry. 
She understands the feelings of her elder brother who arranges many suits, but each suitor rejects her. 
The reason------she is called a witch. 

Her mother was a prostitute. 
She bears this eternal stigma, spoken of as a devourer of men only fit to attract the lowest of lows. 
This, anyway, is the circumstance of her thoughts. Feeling despised and believing the world's judgment, 
the pure-hearted girl has still never been kissed. 

Nevertheless, prince Walt tirelessly searches for a noble, marriagable aristocrat. 
At last he finds Eya, who is different from the others. Eya agrees to marry the princess. 
There was no reason for celebration, for the princess. It seemed too strange a match. 
There must be something... wrong... beneath his visage. 
No matter how she racked her brains the princess can't identify the problem. 
She only feels an eerie dread around his knight. 

What mysterious secret is Eya hiding? 
What hostile truth lurks behind the clouds of what should be a joyous union? 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098943.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
奥格兰王国的公主已经21岁了。作为王国的继承人，她必须结婚。
她理解为她安排了许多相亲的哥哥的好意，但每位求婚者都拒绝了她。
原因——她被称为魔女。

她的母亲曾是妓女。
她背负着这永恒的耻辱，被说成是只配吸引最底层男人的食男者。
这就是她内心的想法。感到被鄙视并相信世人的评判，
这个纯情的女孩至今还没有被吻过。

尽管如此，沃尔特王子不知疲倦地寻找着高贵、可婚配的贵族。
终于他找到了一个与众不同的人——艾亚。艾亚同意迎娶公主。
公主并没有庆祝的理由。这桩婚事看起来太蹊跷了。
他的外表之下一定隐藏着什么……不对劲的东西……
无论她怎么绞尽脑汁，公主都找不出问题所在。
她只是在他的骑士身边感到一种诡异的恐惧。

艾亚隐藏着什么神秘的秘密？
在本应是喜庆联姻的云层背后，潜伏着什么样的敌意真相？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098943.html]DLSite English[/url]]
